subject: Fix bad memory accounting for sds when no malloc_size available (#694)
reason: The change swaps s_malloc_size for s_malloc_usable_size in sdsAllocSize for SDS_TYPE_5 strings. These differ only when HAVE_MALLOC_SIZE is undefined, i.e. a build compiled with NO_MALLOC_USABLE_SIZE on a libc without malloc_usable_size/malloc_size; on every default Linux build (jemalloc, tcmalloc, or glibc) HAVE_MALLOC_SIZE is defined and zmalloc_usable_size(p) is #defined to zmalloc_size(p) (src/zmalloc.h:160), so the patched code compiles to exactly the parent's code. The fuzzer cannot control compile-time flags, so on the runner-supplied builds the change and parent are behaviorally identic
